dialogues.speaker: Hiroyuki
dialogues.text: Yes. I'm currently considering conflict scenarios versus the Shogun's Army.

dialogues.speaker: Hiroyuki
dialogues.text: I've fought against the enforcers of the Vision Hunt Decree before. I know how strong they are.

dialogues.speaker: Hiroyuki
dialogues.text: By contrast, we Sangonomiya troops suffer from a severe material shortage. Watatsumi Island's production capacities just can't keep up. A war of attrition is therefore strictly disadvantageous to us.

dialogues.speaker: Hiroyuki
dialogues.text: Not to mention how Vision wielders are in the vast minority. How long can us ordinary people stand against the Vision Hunt Decree?

dialogues.speaker: Hiroyuki
dialogues.text: *sigh* This path of resistance is an arduous one indeed...
